t: You're looking at The Building Worker, a bronze statue on a granite pedestal at Tower Bridge Piazza, near Tower Hill. It is a memorial to construction workers who have died on building sites in Great Britain, and it's also known as the Unknown Construction Worker. The figure wears a worker's uniform and holds a spirit level, and it's loosely based on Michelangelo's David. It was sculpted by Alan Wilson and cost one hundred thousand pounds.
